# v3.1.0 — Module 3 Applied Learning and Process Flows

## Module 3 learning-design completion

- Adds a separate, topic-specific Mermaid process flow to all 35 Module 3 lessons while preserving the conceptual SVG decision models.
- Adds a practitioner-ready applied artifact, checklist, control record, or worked calculation to every topic.
- Links quantitative lessons directly to their datasets and replaces generic related-concept blocks with topic-specific routes.
- Expands the Rivermark capstone into a complete sourcing-to-procure-to-pay exercise and worked solution, including make-or-buy economics, total cost, HHI, design trade-offs, supplier scoring, contract controls, match exceptions, recovery priorities, and a 90-day plan.

## Data and consistency corrections

- Corrects the control-board quote difference to $13 and the comparison unit to USD per unit.
- Makes the make-or-buy horizon and discount-rate assumption explicit; exposes raw supplier scores and weights; adds design conversion cost and validation risk.
- Adds parent-level supplier-share and three-way-match datasets, bringing the repository to 26 CSV files.
- Aligns five numerical Module 3 visuals with their lessons and datasets and confirms full- and narrow-width raster review of all 35 SVGs.

## Durable quality controls

- Requires Module 3 process flows, applied sections, quantitative dataset links, topic-specific related concepts, reproducible calculations, a substantive capstone solution, and credible assessment distractors in automated validation.
- Adds reproducible lesson-enrichment and visual-review scripts so future edits can be checked without recreating the remediation manually.
